channel.title: EOLkits — AWS Deprecation Radar
channel.description: Tracked AWS deprecation milestones for Lambda runtimes and Amazon Linux 2, with provider source links and bounded migration checks to validate.

item.title: Amazon Linux 2 EOL — milestone 2026-06-30
item.description: Deadline 2026-06-30 (critical). Amazon Linux 2 reached end of life on 2026-06-30 and should be migrated to Amazon Linux 2023. AWS has published post-EOL AL2 releases, so EOLkits does not equate the date with proof that a specific instance has received no later update; verify the installed release and current AWS support terms. Migration checks to validate: Standard support ended; remaining update/support behavior must be verified with AWS; yum replaced with dnf; amazon-linux-extras not available; ntpd replaced with chronyd; iptables replaced with nftables; Python 2 no longer available. Provider status source: https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/aws/update-on-amazon-linux-2-end-of-life/

item.title: Lambda Node.js 20 create/update restrictions — milestone 2027-02-01
item.description: Deadline 2027-02-01 (high). Node.js 20 Lambda runtime (Amazon Linux 2023) deprecated 2026-04-30. Per the AWS Lambda runtime deprecation table, AWS blocks creating new nodejs20.x functions on 2027-02-01 and updating existing ones on 2027-03-03 — part of the synchronized Q1-2027 runtime-block cluster. Migration checks to validate: CreateFunction and UpdateFunctionConfiguration API calls fail; aws-sdk v2 not available (use v3); OpenSSL 3 hash changes; URL vs require() for imports. Provider status source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/lambda-runtimes.html

item.title: Lambda Python 3.9 create/update restrictions — milestone 2027-02-01
item.description: Deadline 2027-02-01 (high). Python 3.9 Lambda runtime (Amazon Linux 2) was deprecated on 2025-12-15 (no further security patches). Per the AWS Lambda runtime deprecation table, AWS blocks creating new python3.9 functions on 2027-02-01 and blocks updating existing ones on 2027-03-03. Functions keep running, but become unpatched and unmodifiable after the block dates. Migration checks to validate: distutils module removed; imp module removed; collections.Mapping deprecated; Native wheels may not be available. Provider status source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/lambda-runtimes.html

item.title: Lambda Python 3.10 projected create/update restrictions — milestone 2027-02-01
item.description: Deadline 2027-02-01 (high). AWS currently projects Python 3.10 Lambda runtime deprecation on 2026-10-31, blocking new python3.10 functions on 2027-02-01, and blocking updates on 2027-03-03. AWS marks future runtime dates as subject to change. Migration checks to validate: datetime.utcnow() deprecated; Various typing changes. Provider status source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/lambda-runtimes.html

item.title: Lambda Node.js 16 create/update restrictions — milestone 2027-02-01
item.description: Deadline 2027-02-01 (high). Node.js 16 Lambda runtime (Amazon Linux 2) deprecated 2024-06-12. Per the AWS Lambda runtime deprecation table, AWS blocks creating new nodejs16.x functions on 2027-02-01 and updating existing ones on 2027-03-03 — the same synchronized Q1-2027 block cluster as nodejs18.x, nodejs20.x, and several Python runtimes. Migration checks to validate: Upgrade target is nodejs24.x (multi-step: no direct nodejs16.x to nodejs24.x runtime setting); aws-sdk v2 preinstalled on nodejs16.x; nodejs18.x+ bundles AWS SDK for JavaScript v3 instead (require('aws-sdk') stops resolving); Native addons must be rebuilt and tested on the Node.js 24 ABI; OpenSSL 3 behavior changes. Provider status source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/lambda-runtimes.html

item.title: Lambda Node.js 18 create/update restrictions — milestone 2027-02-01
item.description: Deadline 2027-02-01 (high). Node.js 18 Lambda runtime (Amazon Linux 2) deprecated 2025-09-01. Per the AWS Lambda runtime deprecation table, AWS blocks creating new nodejs18.x functions on 2027-02-01 and updating existing ones on 2027-03-03 — part of the synchronized Q1-2027 runtime-block cluster. Migration checks to validate: Upgrade target is nodejs24.x; aws-sdk v2 not bundled (use @aws-sdk v3 modular clients); Native addons must be rebuilt and tested on the Node.js 24 ABI; OpenSSL 3 behavior changes. Provider status source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/lambda-runtimes.html

item.title: Lambda Python 3.8 create/update restrictions — milestone 2027-02-01
item.description: Deadline 2027-02-01 (high). Python 3.8 Lambda runtime (Amazon Linux 2) deprecated 2024-10-14. Per the AWS Lambda runtime deprecation table, AWS blocks creating new python3.8 functions on 2027-02-01 and updating existing ones on 2027-03-03 — the same synchronized Q1-2027 block cluster as python3.9/3.10. Migration checks to validate: Upgrade target is python3.12 (3.13 available); distutils and imp removed in 3.12 (fix on upgrade); collections ABCs moved to collections.abc (3.10+); Native wheels may need version bumps for cp312. Provider status source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/lambda-runtimes.html

item.title: Lambda Node.js 22 projected create/update restrictions — milestone 2027-06-01
item.description: Deadline 2027-06-01 (medium). Node.js 22 Lambda runtime (Amazon Linux 2023) has a projected deprecation date of 2027-04-30. AWS currently projects blocking new nodejs22.x functions on 2027-06-01 and updates on 2027-07-01; AWS marks runtime dates as subject to change. Migration checks to validate: Upgrade target is nodejs24.x; Native addons must be rebuilt and tested on the Node.js 24 ABI. Provider status source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/lambda-runtimes.html

item.title: Lambda Python 3.11 projected create/update restrictions — milestone 2027-07-31
item.description: Deadline 2027-07-31 (medium). AWS currently projects Python 3.11 Lambda runtime deprecation on 2027-06-30, blocking new python3.11 functions on 2027-07-31, and blocking updates on 2027-08-31. AWS marks future runtime dates as subject to change. Migration checks to validate: distutils is removed in Python 3.12; Native dependencies may need Python 3.12-compatible wheels. Provider status source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/lambda-runtimes.html
